reasoning: 21.10.3（SA13.3）規定 Recall Last 會還原收音機上次的狀態。「還原上次狀態」需要兩個方向都驗才完整：上次為開則開、上次為關則關——只驗其中一個方向無法與 SA13.1（永遠關）或 SA13.2（永遠開）區分，這正是本條與另兩條的判別點。兩個方向是同一設定值下的兩個輸入情境，依 §8.3 各自成一筆。ER 以收音機開關狀態與音訊輸出判定，與 INT-014／015 一致。優先級：兩筆皆 P1。

distinguishing_axis.delta: 兩筆分別為關機前收音機開啟與關閉兩種上次狀態，證明還原而非固定行為

tcs.test_item:
The system shall restore the previous radio state after an ignition cycle when Auto-On Radio is set to Recall Last.

(Radio was on before the ignition cycle)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The radio in the vehicle has a power button and is not an ICS radio
2. Auto-On Radio is set to Recall Last
3. Before the ignition is switched off, the radio is on
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Switch the ignition off and read the state of the HU
2. Switch the ignition on and wait until the HU has completed start-up
3. Read the state of the radio and listen to the audio output of the HU
tcs.expected_result:
1. The HU is switched off
2. The HU has completed start-up
3. The radio is on and audio is output from the HU speakers, matching the state before the ignition cycle

tcs.test_item:
The system shall restore the previous radio state after an ignition cycle when Auto-On Radio is set to Recall Last.

(Radio was off before the ignition cycle)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The radio in the vehicle has a power button and is not an ICS radio
2. Auto-On Radio is set to Recall Last
3. Before the ignition is switched off, the radio is off
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Switch the ignition off and read the state of the HU
2. Switch the ignition on and wait until the HU has completed start-up
3. Read the state of the radio and listen to the audio output of the HU
tcs.expected_result:
1. The HU is switched off
2. The HU has completed start-up
3. The radio is off and no audio is output from the HU speakers, matching the state before the ignition cycle
